dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Consistent linear reduction in pixel width observed from the maximum lateral span at the pectoral region toward the posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Primary deviations consist of symmetrical convexities corresponding to pectoral fin placement; trunk margins exhibit a smooth, continuous curvature without localized indentations or bulges.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median intensity falls within a medium-light grey range with a blueish spectral bias; significantly lower reflectance than mature white specimens.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Low-frequency diffuse gradient transition between the primary dorsal surface and the shadow-casting side of the longitudinal ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly defined central dorsal ridge creating a linear contrast boundary and a high-contrast circular aperture at the cranial-dorsal position representing the blowhole.
